verdict.rationale: Gram is an AI control plane and MCP gateway that handles user and organizational tool-call data, so a training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence covers access control, audit logs, shadow-server blocking and telemetry delivery, but nothing about whether customer data is used for model training or how to opt out. Those governance features are adjacent controls and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
